title: Music has always been fun
summary: Garland says music is his whole heart and soul, and Turetsky says jazz grew too serious in the 1940s.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: Uh-huh. It sounds like music has always been funfor you?
OH, that's my whole heart and soul.
I hear that in your music and I hear that when I talk to you and I feel it. And it sounds like most of the New Orleans musicians, I mean they raised hell all the time --
But they had a lot of fun.
And it seems as though when time went on, the jazz musicians, got very serious in the '40's and
Concerned with different things and it seemed though music wasn't so much fun. And I always thought, also, that music has to be fun, you have to love what you do.
It was always fun for me and I love it. Anything I love better than it is more of it. You're laughing back, at that.
